reading.body:
OptimumHQ is a facility in Mesa, Arizona with no confirmed operator on file and no published power specifications. The registry located it at a shared multi-tenant address that also lists another facility name, suggesting this may be office or colocation space rather than a dedicated data center campus. Without an operator website, distinguishing business address, or operator-published specifications, this entry cannot be verified as an active AI infrastructure asset.

Arizona has 56 mapped data center facilities, of which only four publish power capacity figures totaling 512 MW. OptimumHQ ranks fifth in the state by published megawatts, but this ranking reflects missing data rather than a confirmed position. The state context indicates that most mapped facilities in Arizona, like this one, disclose no capacity to the public.

This facility cannot be assessed for AI significance. No power specification, operator identity, or architectural detail is published. The entry remains an open research item requiring manual verification or a working operator lookup tool to confirm whether OptimumHQ is an active data center, its scale, or its relevance to AI infrastructure.
